sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Sixth Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CXXII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXXII OF
1996
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly
is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(I) This Ordinance tray be called the
Representation of the People (Sixth Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section14, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE CXXII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXXII OF
1996
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly
is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 14,
Act LXXXV of 1976.‑‑In the Representation of the People Act,
1976 (LXXXV of 1976), hereinafter referred to as :the said Act, in section 14,
after subsection (5), the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"(5A) If a Tribunal
constituted under subsection (5) is, on the basis of information or material
coming to its knowledge from any source, satisfied that a candidate whose
nomination paper has been accepted is a defaulter of loan, taxes, Government
dues or utility charges or has had any loan written off or suffers from any
other disqualification from being elected as a member of an Assembly, it may
suo motu call upon such candidate to show cause why his nomination paper should
not be rejected, and if it is satisfied that the candidate is a defaulter as
aforesaid or has had a loan written off or suffers from any disqualification,
may reject his nomination paper."

1996

An Ordinance further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st December, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly
is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
3. Insertion of new section 46‑A,
Act LXXXV of 1976.‑‑In the said Act after section 46, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"46‑A. Commission to
publish nomination papers, etc. The Commission shall, within six weeks from the
last date for making nominations appointed by it under section 11, publish the
nomination papers, declarations, statements and other documents accompanying
the nomination papers delivered to the Returning Officers tinder section 12 for
information of the general public."
